svg.title: Telescopic handler — Skotbómulyftari
svg.desc: A four-wheel handler extends a sloping telescopic boom to a pair of horizontal load forks.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-telehandler","label_en":"Telescopic handler","label_is":"Skotbómulyftari","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["lifting","material-handling"],"description":"A four-wheel handler extends a sloping telescopic boom to a pair of horizontal load forks.","design_note":"An angled extendable boom ending in forks distinguishes the telehandler from a mast forklift or crane hook.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
